themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions in research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code, impacting the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools designed to support various research activities, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI for design
themes.description: Discusses AI applications in the design process, including AI-generated interfaces, design tools, and the impact on designers' roles.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots in various applications, including user interaction and information retrieval.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing and research purposes, including their biases and reliability.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI analyzes customer data and interactions to generate actionable insights for businesses and product development.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers AI's role in automating or enhancing usability testing processes, from test design to result analysis.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Explores AI's ability to analyze and understand user sentiment and feedback from various sources.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Addresses how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
